unit.title: Verb Tenses and a Day in Your Life

lesson.title: Review Day: Verb Tenses and a Day in Your Life
lesson.subject: punjabi

contentBlocks.text: ਇਸ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਤਿੰਨ ਕਾਲ ਸਿੱਖੇ। ਆਓ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਦੁਹਰਾਈਏ! (This week you learned three tenses. Let's review it all!)

Quick review: past tense shows something already happened, like ਗਿਆ/ਗਈ (Day 1). Future tense shows something not yet happened, like ਜਾਵਾਂਗਾ/ਜਾਵਾਂਗੀ (Day 2). ਉੱਠਿਆ, ਸਵੇਰ, and ਰੋਜ਼ are daily-life words (Day 3). You wrote a full day using all three tenses (Day 4). Write the past, present, and future tense of ਜਾਣਾ (masculine), then read your Day 4 sentences aloud one more time.
ਬਹੁਤ ਵਧੀਆ ਕੰਮ! (Wonderful work!) You mastered a whole tense system and wrote about your own day this week. Next week we'll keep building your Punjabi skills.

objectives: Review this week's past/present/future tense system and daily-life vocabulary
Correctly write all three tenses of ਜਾਣਾ (masculine) from memory
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Do the quick walk-through review of all 4 days together, out loud.
2. Have the child write the three tenses of ਜਾਣਾ from memory.
3. Have the child reread their Day 4 sentences.
4. Complete the review worksheet.
5. Celebrate finishing a full week mastering verb tenses!
differentiationTips: Struggling: allow the child to look back at Day 2's worksheet while writing the review answers, rather than requiring pure recall
Ready for more: ask the child to write all three tenses of a different verb (ਖਾਣਾ) they learned this week
This is a good checkpoint to note which of the three tenses needs the most review before next week
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a recall and review activity — check that the child correctly writes ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹਾਂ (present), ਗਿਆ (past), and ਜਾਵਾਂਗਾ (future) for the masculine form of ਜਾਣਾ.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Consolidates this week's 'grammar mastery' tense system before the course continues, matching the established Day-5-review pacing used across every unit this session.
